description: This file defines a singleton-like structure 'ConfigStore' as an enum with static methods and internal types for managing configuration overrides, loading/saving configurations from local storage, remote gateway, and handling override scenarios in a Swift application.

classes.name: OverrideStore
classes.description: An internal actor class managing the current set of configuration overrides with thread-safe access.

methods.name: isRemoteMode
methods.description: Asynchronously determines if the app is in remote mode based on overrides or connection state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads configuration data, either from remote gateway or local storage, depending on mode and overrides.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Asynchronously saves configuration data either remotely or locally, with override support.

methods.name: loadFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches configuration snapshot from a remote gateway.

methods.name: saveToGateway
methods.description: Saves configuration data to a remote gateway.

methods.name: _testSetOverrides
methods.description: Debug function to set override configurations for testing.

methods.name: _testClearOverrides
methods.description: Debug function to clear override configurations for testing.
